mutation.note: Third try (tries 1 and 2 under the floor). 101 of 110; 8 equivalent: the start and step of two row counters whose gaps the following SORTs close, and the two guards before those SORTs (> to >=, 2 to 3), which differ only for an empty or one-row list. The ninth, mode=keep to overwrite on the calibration dictionary, is a gap: a repeated Instrument ID with two statuses would show it.
